title: SANE: State Anomaly Neutralization for Stable Extreme-Context Delta-Rule Models
selection_reason: The abstract studies RWKV-7 delta-rule recurrent models with fixed-size O(1) inference memory and extreme contexts, then proposes chunk-boundary state compression to avoid numerical failure while retaining reasoning. It is directly relevant to long-context recurrent LLM inference stability and memory.
